method: scripts/qa/sweep-eye-clearance-spots.ts (legality) then sweep-eye-clearance-live.mjs (analytic eye seats vs canonical shot surfaces) then scripts/qa/verify-eye-clearance-runtime.mjs (teleports the REAL player to every flagged spot, matching stance, and re-probes from the actual camera seat - i.e. after src/camera-eye-clearance.ts resolveEyeClearance runs)
roster: All three stages derive the arena roster from SELECTABLE_ARENAS in src/map-selection.ts - stage 1 imports it, stages 2 and 3 scrape it through scripts/qa/eye-clearance-roster.mjs (floor of 7, so a scrape that stops matching throws instead of yielding an empty roster). `ceilings` must therefore carry exactly one entry per selectable arena, no more and no fewer: scripts/qa/eye-clearance-sweep-contract.test.mjs FAILS when the roster and this ledger disagree, which is what let the five-id ceiling set outlive a seven-arena game unnoticed.

accepted.reason: The panels are authored solid:false, shots:true - deliberately walk-through range fixtures you shoot targets through. A player standing inside one clips by design; making them movement-solid would change what the range IS. Accepted, not deferred.

measured.note: First real measurement. 3688 legal hug spots, 25816 traces, ZERO violations across all three stances - entered at 0, the strictest possible ceiling and the measured value.

RE-MEASURED after the 100 x 76 m layout rebuild (was 76 x 58 m). 3467 legal hug spots, 24269 traces, ZERO violations across all three stances; stage 3 teleported the real player to every flagged spot and had none to check. The ceiling stays at 0 - it is not re-pinned, because the measurement did not move off it. The SPOT COUNT moved (3665 -> 3467) and that is expected: the bounds changed, the thinning stride went 4 -> 5 with the larger collider set, and 21 paving slabs replaced 10 terrace bands. The rebuild also cut colliders-with-no-legal-adjacent-stance from 24 to 9; the 24 were all veranda balustrade, and the veranda is demolished. The 9 that remain are the same instrument limitation the old note recorded - the sweep evaluates hug candidates against a hardcoded ground plane of 0, so it asks whether a player can stand beside a +3.40 m upper-room wall from grade. Tracked as the per-candidate standing-surface follow-up, not a map defect.

openRegressions.note: NOT re-baselined. The ceilings were set 2026-08-29 against a sweep whose legality probe modelled a capsule 0.75 m underground (fixed 60886c35), so it measured far fewer legal spots than exist. The instrument got stricter and more complete, which means these rows are candidates for spots the old sweep could not see rather than a new defect in the map. Raising the ceiling to 6 would forgive them unexamined. Triage each row, then either fix it or accept it explicitly the way the `accepted` block does.

NOT re-baselined, same reason, and this one is the loudest signal in the sweep. Legal spots went 2386 -> 2944 and colliders-with-no-legal-stance 4 -> 0 when the probe was corrected, so the corrected instrument is seeing most of this arena for the first time. 55 violations across stand/prone/crouch is exactly the 'I can see through walls when I hug them' class the owner keeps reporting, and it deserves a real look rather than a bigger number in this file.
